notes.title: Servers shutdown announcement
notes.content:
Captains!

This is LUCKCATCHERS2 development team speaking. Today we come to you with sad news — we have decided to cease working on the project, and the game servers will be shut down within the next three weeks.

First of all, we want to express our gratitude to each of you for the time you have devoted to the world on the edge of the Inside Out. It was you who made it alive and created truly exciting adventures with your presence!

Throughout our game's lifespan, we have strived to make it as interesting, deep and thoughtful as possible. But, unfortunately, LUCKCATCHERS2 continued to be an unprofitable project, which was becoming increasingly difficult to support, and now it has become almost impossible.

We apologize if we did not live up to your expectations. We did our best, truly!

In order to add some bright memories to this farewell, we will gift 1.000.000.000 gold to every player, so that during these few days you can enjoy the chaos to your heart's content, try all the things that were interesting but previously unavailable, and just have fun!

The final shutdown of the game servers is scheduled for February 17th, after which it will be impossible to enter the game.

Thank you for the time spent with us. Who knows - maybe we will see you in the air sometime again!

Sincerely,
LUCKCATCHERS2 development team

notes.title: Update 7.62

notes.title: Update 7.61 - Chasing snowflakes

notes.title: Back in business! - Update 7.57
notes.content:
Captains!

Many of you probably saw our previous announcement, where we talked about the problems we were experiencing at the time. We are happy to announce that the situation has been resolved, and we have no plans to stop working on the game for any reason at the moment. Thank you for staying with us!

Now, let's take a look at the changelog of today's update:

[list]
[*] Fixed cases where the "Property" tab did not work correctly when displaying a large list (for example, for large guilds)
[*] Fixed camera behavior when flying close to the ground
[*] Added the ability to upgrade the wall in the Sawmill after the 9th level
[*] Fixed issues in the Chinese localization
[*] Settlement buildings that have been destroyed by deterioration are no longer immediately removed, and can be repaired
[*] Buildings no longer deteriorate when the settlement is under the protection of the Inside Out
[*] In case the reward is sufficient and the weight is suitable, game characters can also take on your transportation job now.
[/list]

We would also like to point out that we are aware of a bug that may cause buildings in the settlement to be destroyed incorrectly and are working on pinpointing and fixing it.

See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Your unique chance
notes.content:
Dear friends, partners, players!

We have to publish this message because we want our project to live. LUCKCATCHERS2, a game made using our own engine, sporting unique gameplay and a loyal player base, is looking for a new owner.

The project has been developed over several years with great love and attention to detail. A lot of effort has been put into it to create an exciting game world that attracts the players' attention and keeps them entertained. Our favorite game now requires additional investment and time for further growth and development, which we, unfortunately, cannot provide ourselves.

The game has all the necessary components for successful continuation and development. Fully documented source code, unique server architecture and a well-organized team of developers. An active community of players supporting and even partaking in developing the game is another significant advantage of the project. During the game's lifetime, we have received many positive reviews and attracted hundreds of active users, which confirms the potential for further growth.

We are sorry to have to part with this project, as it requires more time and resources than we can provide. We are confident that the new owner will be able to take the game to a new level and achieve even greater success. This is an unique opportunity for those who are ready to invest effort and funds in the further development of the game and its promotion on the market.

We are open to offers and are ready to consider various options for cooperation. The price is negotiable. More detailed information will be provided upon request. For more information and to discuss the terms of the deal, please contact us by email: [b]contact@lc2.ae[/b]. Please tell us a little about yourself in advance so that we know we are entrusting our project to safe hands. We will respond to every request.

Thanks to all the players, you people are the best! We count on you!

Sincerely, The Development Team.

notes.title: "Royal Vulture" update
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.56 has just been uploaded to the game server. We know it was a long wait and hope that you will enjoy all the new features! Full changelog is as follows:

• The pet "Royal Vulture" has been added - a magestic and proud creature that will follow you anywhere and assist you in combat, while also showing everyone your status.
• During extraction, 7 times fewer resources are burned now — thus, the total volume of extraction has been significantly increased.
• Added the ability to train settlement Managers and specialize them.
• The number of task slots for the guest in the settlement is now proportional to the levels of both the guest and owner characters — i.e. for the most effective use of someone else's settlement, the guest character must also be of a high level. This change will not affect the interaction with your own settlement in any way.
• Added playing cards.
• Saving gunners increases the character's reputation in their race.
• When a new character enters the game for the first time, two options are now available: to arrive with adventures on Sorcharon or to appear in the city right away.
• Tutorial progress is now reset only 10 minutes after the character exits the game — if you reconnect during this period, training will continue from where it left off.
• Fixed situations when a "Character unavailable" notification appeared when trying to connect to the game.
• The skill "Wolf 100" now requires 1 level of the skill "Production of warships"
• The skill "Paladin" now requires 2 levels of the skill "Production of warships"
• Improved stability.
• Some interface improvements.

See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Global rollback
notes.content:
Captains!

Every player who entered the game during that period will be compensated with 100.000 gold.

We also inform you in advance that the next update may be delayed since we need to apply patches and fixes.

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Critical issue has been fixed
notes.content:
Captains!

A new update is planned for release in the coming days, which will introduce several new mechanics to the game - for example, upgrading Managers of your settlements. Also, resource extraction will become much more efficient - so get ready for increased influx of raw materials! In addition, you should expect an unusual cosmetic feature!

See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Maintenance
notes.content:
Captains!

After the maintenance is over, the state of the game world will be rolled back once again. We estimate it to go back about a day. Every player who entered the game during the last 24 hours, will be compensated with 100.000 gold.

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Another global rollback
notes.content:
Captains!

As you know, we have rolled back the state of the game world twice lately. Sadly, we will have to do that another time. As it turned out, the precautionary measures installed by us weren't enough. We were able to reduce the length of the rollback, however.

The state of the game world will be returened to how it was on July 1st, 2024, 11:51 UTC. Every player who entered the game at least once during that period, will be compensated with 100.000 gold.

This time, we decided not to interfere with bastion attack schedule, since it's still possible to set the time for the pending battle, and the rollback itself isn't critically lengthly. However, if you disagree with that decision, do let us know. We will consider it in case the issue repeats itself.

We apologize for any inconvenience - we don't like this situation as much as you, and are focusing our efforts on mitigating it.

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Maintenance is over
notes.content:
Captains!

The game server is back online. It turned out that the recent issue that caused us to roll the state of the world back, happened again. Thus, we had to do the rollback again as well. The state of the world has been reset to how it was on June 26th, 12:52 UTC.

We've conducted a thorough analysis and comparison between these two cases and implemented all the necessary fixes to ensure it doesn't happen again.

Just like last time, every player who has entered the game at least once between June 26th and 28th, will be credited a compensation of [b]100.000 gold[/b].

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Update 7.55
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.55 has just been uploaded to the game server. The changes aren't many, but they are very important!

Notable adjustments have been made to in-game payments: the cost of Clover in real currency has been reduced several times. You can view the new price on the purchase screen.

Players who made purchases before the release of update 7.55, will be compensated. The compensation will be calculated as follows:
[list]
[*] All the Clover purchased by a player starting from January 4, 2024, is summed up;
[*] The current balance of Clover on their account is added to this amount;
[*] The resulting amount is multiplied by 10 — the approximate ratio of the old Clover value to the new one;
[*] The new balance of Clover on the account is equal to this result.
[/list]

In other words, these players will receive all the Clover they've ever bought a second time, adjusted for its new price.

Apart from that, several fixes were made, aimed at improving client stability.

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Update 7.52
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.52 has just been uploaded to the server, and has brought some interesting stuff with it!

Now, you can paint your airship as you see fit - time to get creative!

Adopting a uniform color for your whole guild to boost the comradeship - easy!
Capturing a Bastion while piloting some very red, and thus very fast, ship - piece of cake!
Making your cargo transporting day brighter by doing it aboard your most astonishing vessel - yes please!

And that's just a couple of examples of how you can use this new feature. We're sure you'll enjoy it - so go ahead, pick the closest town to you and visit the Docking Port there!

But that's not all of the novelties. New entities have also been added to the game:
• Special protection crystals - they function much like the already existing ones, but can absorb much more damage. Each one of those has unique stats - and some may really surprise you with their capabilities!
• Guardians' protection crystals - another latest addition. These crystals can be recharged by spending mana!

And we should probably give you a little hint on how to find these wonders. We heard that one should take a closer look at the Inside Out.

That's it from us, and the rest is up to you to try out! See you in the air!

notes.title: Update 7.43

notes.content:
Captains!

The 7.42 update is already uploaded to the game server. New opportunities, quality of life improvements and other changes will surely be to your liking! You can find the full changelog below:

A [b]Settlement manager[/b] allows to control your settlement remotely, again - even when your character is not around.
Representatives may be [b]upgraded[/b] into Settlement managers in flying cities.

[*] It is now possible to produce triple-barrel 37 lb cannons.
[*] A skill branch dedicated to miphril processing has been added.
[*] Improvements to the game's client stability.
[/list]
See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team
